title: Multilingual Holistic Bias: Extending Descriptors and Patterns to Unveil Demographic Biases in Languages at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing machine translation quality (spBLEU) and evaluating multilingual sentence embedding similarities (cosine distance) between masculine and feminine translations of gender-ambiguous source sentences.
